photos.caption: NASA's video, clock 15:40:50
photos.how: Frame from NASA's video at 1599 s; on-screen clock 04/17/13 15:40:50, wanted 15:40:50 (within 20 s; the matrix time plus one day). NASA's as-run matrix gives this test's start as 'GMT13-106 15:40' on 2013-04-16 (`as run matrix!B101`), read as 2013-04-16 15:40. The video's on-screen clock reads one day later than the matrix on every day both cover, the same kind of offset NASA states for this clock on BASS-II, so the clock was searched for 2013-04-16 plus one day, 15:40: it was found 1549 s into this video, where the clock runs at about real speed (1.0 s per s); it is also found in 1 sped-up video(s), listed as further `video` rows. The fan setting on screen (52) is one the matrix's fan cell gives ('52, pot 0.4, 0.35 ', `as run matrix!J101`).
